title: VECTOR BREAKTHROUGH #2 TRIAL FROM MISERY LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 VECTOR BREAKTHROUGH #2 TRIAL FROM MISERY LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10

DETAILS: Vector Breakthrough will be open for a limited time. During the event, players can complete event stages to obtain 'Caution! Wet Floor!', and increase the level of Breakthrough Milestones to obtain event rewards.
[Breakthrough Milestones]
REWARDS: EPOQUE Collection - My Fellow Newsboy for Greyy, Event Furniture, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
02 SUPPLY & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
03 ORIENTEERING HEADHUNTING OPEN FOR A LIMITED TIME

DETAILS: During the event, you can select and lock in three 6-star and three 5-star Operators of this pool and raise their rates. The three selected 6-star Operators will be the only 6-star Operators in this headhunting.
All possible Operators:
★★★★★★(2%): Entelechia / Mon3tr / Haruka / Ascalon / Vina Victoria / Vulpisfoglia
★★★★★(8%): Quercus / Vetochki / Mitm / Santalla / Lunacub / Alanna
NOTE:

◆ This is a Standard Headhunting. Once the rate-up Operators are selected, only the three selected 6-star Operators will appear in this pool, making up 100% of the 6-star Operators' pull rate. All 5-star Operators from the Standard Headhunting pool may appear, while the three selected 5-star Operators have a boosted rate, comprising 60% of the 5-star Operators' pull rate.
◆ For the duration of the current Orienteering Headhunting pool, the rate-up Operators cannot be changed.
04 HYMN TO A NEW BEGINNING SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in to receive Headhunting Permit * 1 and Event Icon 'New Start'.
05 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[Advanced Training Resource Pack]
DETAILS: Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Professional Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2

Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired 6-star Operator to Elite 2 Lv. 1 (effective for 6-star Operators under Elite 2 Lv. 1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
[Orienteering Headhunting Pack]
DETAILS: Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, Originite Prime * 9
[Rhodes Island Data Set]
DETAILS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90
[Rhodes Island Data Pack]
DETAILS: Module Data Block * 12
06 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Sent from Ognisko for Viviana
EPOQUE Collection - Echo of Bagpipes for Bagpipe
EPOQUE Collection - Frosted Steps for Matoimaru
07 KERNEL LOCATING OPEN

DETAILS: During the Kernel Locating, you can pick and lock-in two 6-star Operators and three 5-star Operators as the rated-up Operators for the current banner. Correspondingly, the redeemable Operators in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area] will be shifted into: A 6-star and a 5-star Operator of your choice from the rated-up Operators for the current banner.
All possible Operators:
★★★★★★ (2%): Mizuki / Fartooth / Mudrock / Mountain / Suzuran / Shining / Bagpipe / Siege / Ch'en / Angelina / Mostima / Magallan

★★★★★ (8%): Ashlock / Lappland / Ptilopsis / Texas / Specter / Kafka / Platinum / Mayer / Waai Fu / Istina / Warfarin / Ayerscarpe / Akafuyu / Aosta / Chiave / Asbestos / Broca / Leonhardt / Mr. Nothing / Toddifons / Elysium / Glaucus / Cliffheart / Flint
NOTE: The odds of getting a 6-star Operator due to accumulated rolls in the [Kernel Headhunting] before the shift WILL carry to the [Kernel Locating] banner.
Please stay tuned for more information!
